name: Slack channel sync bootstrap
description: List channels and initialize slack_sync_state after OAuth connect.

steps.name: Map channel rows and sync state
steps.script:
local channel_rows = {}
local channel_ids = {}
for _, ch in ipairs(steps.list_channels.result.channels or {}) do
  local id = ch.id or ""
  if id ~= "" then
    table.insert(channel_ids, id)
    table.insert(channel_rows, {
      external_id = run.external_id,
      channel_id = id,
      name = ch.name,
      is_private = ch.is_private,
      is_archived = ch.is_archived,
      member_count = ch.num_members,
      synced_at = input.synced_at,
      source = "bootstrap",
    })
  end
end
return {
  channel_rows = channel_rows,
  sync_state = {
    external_id = run.external_id,
    connection_id = input.connection_id or "",
    channel_ids = channel_ids,
    backfill_status = "pending",
    backfill_channel_index = 0,
    backfill_cursor = "",
    last_sync_at = input.synced_at,
    poll_interval_seconds = input.poll_interval_seconds or 300,
  },
}
